reviews.title: Way overpriced
reviews.comment: Who is pricing this stuff? I can get a 9800x3d for 200 bucks cheaper and a 7800x3d with a motherboard for 100 cheaper. Seems like a really dumb way to end up sitting on stock. That being said save your money on this CPU considering its basically 5 generations old. If you want to stick with AM5 maybe look into any other ryzen chip on the market. Possibly this same chip through a seller that understands the market
